description: Item source/render contract evidence. This does not certify a whole Core profile or any host adapter.

checks.scope: Escaped text, href and classes, required visible content, variant and size validation, link items without nested actions, and group list semantics

limitations: The public .item namespace owns the default row styles; no runtime is introduced. Bootstrap 5 dropped its media object in favour of flex utilities, and .list-group models joined bordered lists.
